set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state')
if subprocess.run(['tmux','has-session','-t','omega-grid'],capture_output=True).returncode==0:
 raise SystemExit('LEGACY_TMUX_STILL_PRESENT')
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  argv=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
  if len(argv)>1 and argv[0].split(b'/')[-1] in (b'python',b'python3',b'python3.12') and argv[1]==b'/workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py':
   raise SystemExit('LEGACY_PYTHON_STILL_RUNNING')
 except OSError:continue
backup=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/backups/omega_legacy_grid_before_single_owner_20261008_1001.db')
if not backup.is_file():raise SystemExit('LEGACY_BACKUP_MISSING')
v=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(backup)+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
assert v.execute('pragma quick_check(1)').fetchone()[0]=='ok'
v.close()
tid='ingress_fusion-e2e-20261008-v1'
p=root/'inbox'/(tid+'.consumed')
task=json.loads(p.read_text())
if task.get('task_id')!=tid or task.get('owner_id')!='gabriel' or task.get('machine_id')!='omega-vps':
 raise SystemExit('UNBOUND_TASK')
if task.get('effect_authority') is not False or any(k in task for k in ('effect','execution','bridge_op')):
 raise SystemExit('TASK_NOT_SAFE')
if (task.get('cognitive_fusion') or {}).get('grid_preframe',{}).get('round_count')!=3:
 raise SystemExit('MISSING_FUSION')
con=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(root/'omega_runtime.sqlite3')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
exists=con.execute('select count(*) from task where task_id=?',(tid,)).fetchone()[0]
con.close()
if exists:
 print('TASK_ALREADY_IN_CANONICAL_GRID',tid)
else:
 dst=root/'inbox'/(tid+'.json')
 data=json.dumps(task,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2).encode()+b'\n'
 fd=os.open(dst,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(data);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 print('SAFELY_REQUEUED',tid,'bytes',len(data))
print('LEGACY_RETIRED',True,'HISTORICAL_JOURNAL_PRESERVED',True)
